scope: Elected-candidate index, 1871–1986, printed pp366–408. Includes voided/controverted elections; this is a review extraction, not a complete member-tenure dataset.
extraction_revision: 2026-10-21 independent bounded review: header-aligned years; same-baseline fields; service-note separation; two index-name errata; official seat-total comparison
cautions: Structurally accepted means only that the row parsed without a known structural issue. No row is automatically importable without individual OCR/source review.
Pre-1903 affiliation is normally omitted in this index, not proof of political independence.
An asterisk marks a ministerial by-election, not a general election or a service-start date.
1941 LIB./COAL. and CONS./COAL. combine party at election with later coalition; fields are separated.
Index counts include voided/controverted elections; compare seat occurrences, not just person rows, where a candidate won more than one riding.

The two August 2025 errata affecting printed index pp383 and404 are applied to name_corrected. Raw OCR is preserved. Other errata relate to election-result pages or legislative history and are outside this extraction.
